title: Legacy console page routes
responsibility: Parses and formats the earlier commit-based console paths, preserving branch names and view-specific selections.

inputs.name: consoleRoute.path
inputs.description: Console-relative path naming an optional branch, 40-character lowercase hexadecimal commit and supported view, optionally followed by base, record or unit selection.

inputs.name: consoleRoutePath.route
inputs.description: Branch or null, commit, supported view and optional comparison base, history record and selected unit to encode.

outputs.name: consoleViews
outputs.description: Supported view names: map, compare, history, growth and activity.

outputs.name: consoleRoute
outputs.description: Parsed route with decoded branch and selections, or undefined for an invalid page shape, branch encoding or unknown view. Trailing slashes are ignored and unrelated selection parts are skipped.

outputs.name: consoleRoutePath
outputs.description: Canonical commit-based path with encoded branch segments and selections; comparison base appears only for compare and record only for history.
